bigquery: google-cloud-bigquery: Google::Cloud.bigquery hands a client out, and @suss/sql reads BigQuery's own SQL under the same name
container: suss: which table an access reached
data: google-cloud-bigquery: Google::Cloud::Bigquery::Table#data reads the table's rows
insert: google-cloud-bigquery: Table#insert and Dataset#insert stream rows in
insert_async: google-cloud-bigquery: Table#insert_async and Dataset#insert_async stream rows in through a background writer
load: google-cloud-bigquery: Table#load and Dataset#load write rows from a file and wait
load_job: google-cloud-bigquery: Table#load_job and Dataset#load_job start the same write without waiting
new: language: Ruby spells Class#new the same way. Google::Cloud::Bigquery.new builds a client
query: google-cloud-bigquery: Project#query and Dataset#query run a statement and wait for its rows
query_job: google-cloud-bigquery: Project#query_job and Dataset#query_job start the same statement without waiting
scope: suss: which namespace an access reached
